description: This file defines the AutoFilter class for reading auto filter data from an ODS (OpenDocument Spreadsheet) file within the PhpSpreadsheet library. It processes XML data to set auto filters on spreadsheet sheets.

classes.name: AutoFilter
classes.description: Handles reading auto filter configurations from ODS files and applying them to the active spreadsheet sheet.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Initiates the auto filter reading process from the provided XML element representing the workbook data.

methods.name: readAutoFilters
methods.description: Parses database range nodes from the XML and applies auto filters based on the 'target-range-address' attribute.

methods.name: getAttributeValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specified attribute from a DOM node, in a namespace-aware manner.
